15. PW1 is father of minor injured, who deposed that his minor daughter was hit by a speeding Auto due to rash and negligent driving of Respondent No.1.
During crossexamination on behalf of Respondent Nos. 1 and 2, Ld. Counsel for Respondent Nos. 1 and 2 did not put any question in respect of mode and manner of the accident.

No evidence has been led on behalf of any of the respondents to show that there was any negligence on the part of the minor or her mother while crossing the road, which became the cause of the accident.
